title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart — Household Repair and Maintenance Spending
prompt:
The bar chart below shows the average amount of money that households in four cities spent per year on three categories of home repair and maintenance (plumbing, electrical work and painting) in 2023. The figures are given in US dollars.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类小作文（Task 1）练习，主题为“最弱项目补强与迁移复测”。请先观察柱状图的三个类别与四个城市，找出最高值、最低值以及类别之间的差异，再用比较结构（如 twice as much as、the highest、by contrast）组织段落。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷，也不代表任何真实统计数据。写作时不要给出个人观点或解释原因，只描述和比较图中信息，并确保不少于 150 词。
